items.item_text: 01. All applicants are required to submit responses to the following supplemental questions. Your responses will provide information about your background and experience related to this position and will be used in the screening and selection process. Be concise yet specific and informative in your responses to these supplemental questions. "See resume," attachments or links will not be accepted as a substitute for your responses to the questions in the following boxes. Incomplete responses will not be considered. Please indicate below that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes | No

02. I understand that my application will be considered incomplete if any required sections of the application are not completed and/or if any documents that are required are not attached to my online application by the closing date. Options: Yes | No
03. Please specify your highest level of education. Options: High School or equivalent (GED) | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Juris Doctor | Doctorate Degree
04. Do you have an associate's degree or higher in Accounting, or a related field such as Business or Finance? Options: Yes | No
05. If you selected "Yes" to having an associate's degree or higher in a related field, such as Business or Finance, please indicate the field in which you earned your degree:
06. Indicate the full-time equivalent years of experience working in fiscal/financial services. Options: Less than one year | One year | Two years | Three years | Four years | Five years or more

07. Indicate where you have worked to obtain at least two (2) full-time equivalent years of progressively responsible experience working in fiscal/financial services. 1. What was the time frame? 2. What was the employer's name? 3. Describe the work you performed. (This section is required)
08. Do you have work experience in Higher Education? Options: Yes | No

09. If you indicated in the previous question that you have experience working in Higher Education, please specify where you obtained this experience. 1. What was the time frame? 2. What was the employer's name? 3. Describe the work you performed.

10. Indicate your experience preparing bank deposits, including compiling financial data, verifying and balancing receipts, and processing cash, checks, or other forms of payment for deposit. Options: No Experience: I have no experience performing these duties. | Limited Experience: I have limited experience performing these duties and require supervision or guidance. | Moderate Experience: I have some experience performing these duties independently but may occasionally require guidance. | Extensive Experience: I have substantial experience performing these duties independently. | Advanced Experience: I have extensive experience performing these duties independently and have trained or guided others in these procedures.

11. If you indicated in the previous question that you have experience preparing bank deposits, including compiling financial data, verifying and balancing receipts, and processing cash, checks, or other forms of payment for deposit, please specify where you obtained this experience and briefly describe your role.

12. Indicate your experience preparing purchase requisitions. Options: No Experience: I have no experience performing these duties. | Limited Experience: I have limited experience performing these duties and require supervision or guidance. | Moderate Experience: I have some experience performing these duties independently but may occasionally require guidance. | Extensive Experience: I have substantial experience performing these duties independently. | Advanced Experience: I have extensive experience performing these duties independently and have trained or guided others in these procedures.
13. If you indicated in the previous question that you have experience preparing purchase requisitions, please specify where you obtained this experience and briefly describe your role.

14. Describe how you have demonstrated sensitivity and understanding in delivery of services and support to a diverse workforce and student population (diverse in terms of socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic background). This section is required.
A High School Diploma, the equivalent, or higher.
An associate degree, or higher, in Accounting, or a related field such as Business or Finance.
Two years of experience working in fiscal/financial services.

Demonstrated experience working with communities who have been traditionally underserved by higher education and experience in the pedagogy reflecting intersections of race, culture, class, ethnic, and queer communities.
